name: graph
description: Find who calls a symbol, what it calls, or a 1-hop Mermaid diagram. Built from a tree-sitter parse, so symbols are matched by name: same-named methods on different types may be conflated, and dynamic or trait-dispatched calls are not seen. Every answer says so. An empty result is not proof that nothing calls the symbol.

mode.description: Query mode: 'callers', 'callees', or 'mermaid' (default). An unrecognized mode is an error.

depth.description: Traversal depth (1 to 5, default 1) for multi-hop caller/callee trees or Mermaid graphs.
